description.value:
The Ironwood · уровень 14

While wearing your Ironwood Armor, you can use a
Bonus Action to transform into a Large size, bark-covered humanoid if you are in a space large enough. This transformation lasts for 10 minutes, or until you end it early as a Bonus Action, or if you die. You have the following benefits while transformed:
• You gain Temporary Hit Points equal to five times your
Warlock level.
• You have Advantage on attack rolls that you make with
Simple and Martial weapons.
• When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, that attack deals an extra 3d6 Force damage. You can deal this extra damage no more than once on each turn.
You must finish a Long Rest to use this feature again. You may also regain its use by expending the use of one of your Mystic Arcanum (no action required).

Автоматизация / ограничения:

  • Активация размера, временных HP и эффекта — через макрос управления. Урон 3d6 добавляется отдельной кнопкой не чаще раза за ход; восстановление Mystic Arcanum — вручную.

source.custom: Raiders of the Serpent Sea: Heroes’ Handbook
